# Moody College of Communication

> The Moody College of Communication at UT Austin offers undergraduate and graduate programs across journalism, advertising, communication studies, radio-television-film, and speech-language pathology with emphasis on hands-on learning, research innovation, and student media production.

Moody College is one of the leading communication schools in the nation, featuring multiple departments and schools, active research centers, and extensive student media operations. The college serves both undergraduate and graduate students with comprehensive academic, research, and support services.

## Key Topics

- Communication Studies
- Radio-Television-Film
- School of Journalism and Media
- Stan Richards School of Advertising & Public Relations
- Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
- Research Centers and Institutes
- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Programs
- Hands-On Learning
- Student Media Production
- Faculty Excellence
- Research Innovation
- Alumni Network
- Funding Opportunities
- Campus Experience
